gui_interactions.description: Playwright headless Chromium (11 widths) + Firefox (3 widths) against a probe server that serves the repo plus a real /content-index/, so the nav is the real 7-item production one (dev-server.js has no such route); 2 MobileSafari captures via xcrun simctl after xcrun simctl openurl; real swipes (4) and a tap (1) on the phone emulator, force-stop + relaunch and 2 network-radio toggles on the tablet emulator to bring Chrome to a painted page. Assertions per run: 7 nav items, document overflow 0, scrollX 0 after scrollTo(9999,0), nav.scrollWidth <= nav.clientWidth, no item box outside the nav, no same-row box overlap, no overlapping glyph rects, no page errors.

notes: Scope: the branch's only code change is the .param-nav a block inside @media (max-width: 767px) plus a new @media (max-width: 359px) block (commit d5d21b8, 2026-11-10, BEFORE plan_complete.json 2026-11-12). (2) The verdict 'no real overflow / capture artifact' in probe/VERDICT.md matches these numbers. (3) The verification pass itself made no CSS change (e6fe2ba is evidence only; the CSS commit predates the plan). LAYOUT-AUDIT: claude/skills/layout-audit/scripts/audit.py over the nav geometry at 320/390/768 -> 0 HARD failures at every breakpoint (only SOFT 'margins differ' 17/24/24/17, an artifact of using the nav row itself as the board).
